profiles.description: Decentralized privacy infrastructure. Don't rent your VPN. Own it.

Launch on pons. Route fees to any fomo profile.
Name a fomo trader when you launch. At least half of the coin’s creator fees are locked to their profile for as long as it trades. They collect by setting one picture on fomo, with no wallet setup, no gas and no invite.

MOAT reads every token and operator approval a wallet ever granted on Robinhood Chain, Ethereum or Base, from block zero, and shows which are still open. Paste any public address: no wallet, no account, no signature needed to scan.

Every Approval and ApprovalForAll event is read up to one pinned chain head, then each permission is checked live against its token contract at that same block. Broad or flagged access shows in coral, each row carries a score out of 100 with its reasons, and address intelligence is powered by GoPlus Security.

Closing a permission is one ordinary transaction the owning wallet signs: approve(spender, 0) for tokens, setApprovalForAll(operator, false) for operators, no fee to MOAT. The bridge only comes down after MOAT reads the chain again. Every scan exports as a JSON proof anyone can rerun.

A Goldsky index and a ZeroDev gas-sponsored batch revoke are built and switch on as their keys land.

Most wallets never count their bridges. MOAT counts every one.
